summary: A mobile retail clothes rail: a chrome top tube on two uprights over two feet, four swivel castors, and a row… joints castor_0_l, roll_0_l, castor_1_l, roll_1_l, castor_0_r, roll_0_r, …; sockets socket_rail_centre.
setup: Spawn it with Prefabs.clothes_rail or place "prefab": "clothes_rail" in a scene; Game(plugins=[...]) needs physics3d().
